articles.title: Cooper Flagg Meets Owner of Ultra Rare NBA Debut Patch Autograph Card in Video Amid $2M+ Auction
articles.summary: The man who pulled Cooper Flagg's one-of-one, autographed, debut patch Topps Chrome rookie card last month met the Dallas Mavericks superstar himself this past weekend.
articles.body:
The man who pulled Cooper Flagg's one-of-one, autographed, debut patch Topps Chrome rookie card last month met the Dallas Mavericks superstar himself this past weekend.

In a video posted on Instagram , Jason Williams of Clover, South Carolina, documented his trip to Bangor, Maine, for the grand opening of Flagg Trading Co. card shop on Saturday.

The video shows Flagg and Williams meeting, and Flagg congratulating Williams for the card pull of a lifetime.

Brunson Appears in Emmys Opening Video ⭐️

Williams brought the redemption card with him and let Flagg hold it, prompting Flagg to joke that he was going to keep it.

On Aug. 28, Fanatics Collect announced that the Flagg debut patch card pulled by Williams would be going up for auction on its platform:

As of the morning of Sept. 15, the gem mint 10 card had received 36 bids and was sitting at $2.2 million on the Fanatics Collect platform.

Flagg, 19, burst onto the scene last season after going first overall to the Mavs in the 2025 NBA draft.

On the heels of one dominant collegiate season at Duke, Flagg did not disappoint during his NBA debut campaign, averaging 21.0 points, 6.7 rebounds, 4.5 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.0 three-pointer made per game en route to Rookie of the Year honors.

While his debut patch rookie card is set to realize a huge number at auction, the value will likely only continue to grow provided Flagg lives up to his potential and keeps developing into one of the NBA's elite players.

articles.title: Sophie Cunningham Expresses Thoughts on Next WNBA Commissioner, Has Discussed Them With Adam Silver
articles.summary: INDIANAPOLIS (AP) — Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham has discussed the soon-to-be vacant WNBA commissioner's job with Adam Silver after the NBA commissioner reached out to her.
articles.body:
INDIANAPOLIS (AP) — Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham has discussed the soon-to-be vacant WNBA commissioner's job with Adam Silver after the NBA commissioner reached out to her.

"I have talked to Adam Silver a couple times, and I think he's a great guy," Cunningham said Monday after a Fever practice during the women's FIBA World Cup break. "He was very knowledgeable and full of wisdom and so getting to talk to him and hear his perspective of how he approaches the NBA is huge, who he's kind of looking for. I think if you want to know the real answers, you go to him.

"But I think he's going to put someone in place who really wants to take our league to another level than it's already at," Cunningham added. "Our league is booming, so why would we not (want) someone who's going to make it even more booming?"

Current commissioner Cathy Engelbert recently announced she would retire at the end of the year. Silver has a long history of speaking with players about various topics in the NBA or the WNBA, though the NBA declined to specifically address what Silver and Cunningham discussed.

Cunningham, however, was more outspoken about the traits and characteristics she wants to see in the WNBA's next leader, though she didn't share names of any possible candidates she might have in mind.

Cunningham has emerged as a polarizing player this season because of her position on transgender athletes competing in women's and girls sports. She has not backed down from her opinion despite a backlash that has included fans of Cunningham and her stance being confronted at games.

Yet Cunningham believes the league needs a unifier.

"I think the WNBA has always been a place for people to feel safe and comfortable. I think there's all types of walks in this organization, or in this league, which I think is absolutely awesome," Cunningham said. "But I do think with that you need someone who's going to unite everybody because it can be so different. But that doesn't mean it's a bad thing. I think it makes it a lot of fun."

She also wants someone committed to helping the league continue to grow.

The WNBA has seen ticket and merchandising sales, television ratings and interest in the league soar since the Fever drafted Caitlin Clark with the No. 1 selection in 2024 even amid the many controversies about everything from whether the hard fouls that Clark has taken this season are too hard to questions about Englebert's leadership.

Engelbert's accomplishments include signing a new, richer television contract, a new collective bargaining agreement and added charter flights for teams.

Cunningham said it may be time for the league to discuss if playing games on back-to-back nights creates a better product on the court or if they could be eliminated with shorter in-season breaks — though she noted that's part of the reason for higher salaries.

But the biggest thing Cunningham is looking for is someone who values the players.

"I really do think that you need a commissioner who is players' first, who wants a relationship with their players," Cunningham said. "I think that's so important. That doesn't mean we're always going to get along, and we're always going to agree. Like they have a job, they work for the owners, and so they're going to have to make hard decisions. But if you have that open line of communication and that respect level, I think that it just feels different. I think that is a very important piece for our new commissioner."

And regardless of the fans or the critics, Cunningham insists she wants the WNBA to continue its overall mission.

"You continue to have a growth mindset and see other people's walks of life and really get to know why they are the way they are, and I think that's truly fun," she said. "Like you are playing the best basketball, you're in the best league in the entire world and you're getting to learn so much about who you are as a human, how other people are as a human. But with all that, with all the diversity you do need someone who's going to unite our league and have a common goal and get us all on the same page. I think that's super important."

Indiana is waiting for All-Stars Clark and Aliyah Boston and coach Stephanie White to rejoin the team. The trio was part of the United States' gold-medal winning team in Berlin. The Fever resume play on Friday at Toronto.

articles.title: NBA reportedly lacked sufficient evidence to suspend Kawhi Leonard for role in Clippers' investigation
articles.summary: The NBA reportedly did not have enough evidence to challenge the NBPA.
articles.body:
In the wake of the NBA's investigation into whether the Los Angeles Clippers circumvented the salary cap when they signed Kawhi Leonard , one major question has emerged: Did Leonard get off light?

After months of looking into the situation, the NBA finally released its judgement in September. The Clippers and owner Steve Ballmer got the worst of the league's punishment. The team was docked five future first-round picks and Ballmer was fined $30 million and suspended from team activities for a year.

Leonard, meanwhile, received a $700,000 fine. He was not suspended, nor did he have his contract voided, as a result of the NBA's investigation.

Why? Because the NBA reportedly did not have enough evidence to make that move, per ESPN's Shams Charania.

As Charania explained, any attempt by the NBA to suspend Leonard or void his contract would be subject to a battle with the NBPA. Because of that, the league needed to have ironclad evidence in order for a suspension or voiding his contract to actually go through. The NBA apparently did not have that, resulting in Leonard simply receiving a fine for his involvement in the scandal.

That decision didn't sit right with some around the game. Former Clippers player Danilo Gallinari , who was traded due to Leonard signing with the team, took Leonard to task during a podcast appearance, saying Leonard should donate $50 million to charity for his actions. He wasn't the only one who had questions about the severity of Leonard's punishment .

With Leonard free to play at the start of the 2026-27 NBA season, the Clippers and Toronto Raptors agreed to follow through on their offseason trade involving Leonard. The 35-year-old was initially traded back to the Raptors in June, but that trade was put on hold due to the ongoing NBA investigation. Days after the NBA's punishment came down, both teams agreed to complete the deal .

Barring any new evidence, Leonard appears good to go when the Raptors open the 2026-27 NBA season against the Chicago Bulls on Oct. 21. He'll still have to shell out $700,000 for his role in the Clippers' scandal, but that's hardly a concern for a player who's made over $375 million during his career.

articles.title: Jimmer Fredette Ends Retirement, Will Return to USA Basketball 3x3 Ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
articles.summary: Jimmer Fredette is ending his brief retirement in order to resume playing for the United States men's 3x3 national basketball team.
articles.body:
Jimmer Fredette is ending his brief retirement in order to resume playing for the United States men's 3x3 national basketball team.

Fredette announced the decision in a video posted Tuesday on USA Basketball 3x3's official X account:

According to Tim Reynolds of the Associated Press, Fredette is stepping down from his role as managing director of the USA men's 3x3 national team, and he is likely to play in the FIBA 3x3 Phoenix Challenger this weekend.

By coming out of retirement, Fredette is positioning himself to potentially be part of the USA men's 3x3 team at the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.

Fredette, 37, is best known for starring collegiately at BYU where he averaged 25.6 points per game over his final two seasons and was named National College Player of the Year in 2011.

The sharpshooting guard was selected 10th overall in the 2011 NBA draft, but he never managed to establish himself as a major contributor.

Over six NBA seasons with the Sacramento Kings, Chicago Bulls, New Orleans Pelicans, New York Knicks and Phoenix Suns, Fredette averaged 6.0 points, 1.4 assists and 1.0 rebound per game.

Fredette enjoyed greater success overseas in China and Greece, but he seemingly found his calling stateside in 2022 when he began playing for the United States 3x3 national team.

He helped lead Team USA to a silver medal at the 2023 FIBA 3x3 World Cup and later represented the United States at the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris.

However, Fredette suffered a torn adductor during the Olympics, which caused him to miss most of Team USA's games. The Americans finished 2-5 and did not medal.

Although Fredette retired last year to take an administrative role with USA 3x3 basketball, his return could allow him a chance at Olympic redemption in two years.

articles.title: Everything Paul George Said About Jaylen Brown Trade, Fan Backlash, More at Celtics Press Conference
articles.summary: Veteran forward Paul George met with the media on Tuesday for the first time since being traded from the Philadelphia 76ers to the Boston Celtics.
articles.body:
Veteran forward Paul George met with the media on Tuesday for the first time since being traded from the Philadelphia 76ers to the Boston Celtics.

George was shipped up to Boston along with four future draft picks in exchange for star guard Jaylen Brown. Despite receiving a nine-time All-Star from Philadelphia, Celtics fans were underwhelmed with George headlining the trade return for Brown, who endeared himself to the city despite a contentious end to his tenure with the franchise.

George told reporters in Tuesday's introductory press conference that he understood the fans' reaction to the trade, and he won't let it affect his approach to his new team.

"I understand the circumstances. I understand how huge JB was not only for the organization but also here in the city," George said. "So I didn't take [the reaction] personally. [Fans] should have a relationship personally to the trade."

The 36-year-old added that he plans to be one of the team's leaders, but he knows his job is to support Celtics star forward Jayson Tatum.

"Bring a veteran stance. Leadership… Just be a great co-partner to JT," he said. "I think we got an unbelievable roster, an unbelievable coach, obviously, front office. I've always admired everything Boston has done and stood for."

He continued : "We have a superstar and that's JT. I'm not here to necessarily steal the shine or try to reinvent who I am. I'm here to help JT, and he's the guy. I've played alongside another superstar wing, and we coexisted beautifully."

George's past two seasons with the Sixers have been well below his standards. He played in a combined 78 games and saw his scoring average dip below 20 points for the first time since his injury-shortened 2014-15 season.

However, George made it clear that he feels like he's back to his old self after getting healthy, and he expects to be better with the Celtics.

"I feel great again. I feel like I've turned a corner of dealing with injuries, and now kind of reestablishing myself and from a physical standpoint again," he said , later adding , "The past couple years have been rough from a physical standpoint. … I feel great physically. My body naturally has just healed."

In addition to acquiring George, the Celtics added even more veteran leadership this offseason by bringing in longtime point guard Mike Conley Jr. Team president Brad Stevens said the two of them have already made a difference with their leadership.

"You can feel their presence in the building," Stevens told reporters .

The Celtics also landed a major win in free agency when center Mitchell Robinson defected from the 2026 NBA champion New York Knicks to sign with them on a three-year deal. Robinson wasn't present at Tuesday's press conference for personal reasons, but Stevens said he's already been working with the team. He added that he's more than pleased with Boston's offseason.

"I really like this group," Stevens said . "I think this group is going to be good."

George and the new-look Celtics will open the 2026-27 season on Oct. 20 against the Detroit Pistons.

articles.title: Un bronce que anticipa una temporada de Oro: "Disfrutar el mejor baloncesto posible"
articles.standfirst: La ACB y la Liga Femeina Endesa se presentan en una fiesta espectacular
articles.summary: La ACB y la Liga Femeina Endesa se presentan en una fiesta espectacular
articles.body: La Sede de Endesa en Madrid acogió la presentaición oficial de la Liga Endesa y la Liga Femenina 26/27. Un evento especial que se trasladó a un 'Programa de Ortega' especial y emotivo. Por primera vez se juntaron campeones y campeonas para dar el pistoletazo de salida a una temporada espectacular. "Disfrutar el mejor baloncesto posible, organizar bien las cosas para no molestar mucho porque los protagonistas están en el parquet", reconocía Antonio Martín, presidente de la ACB que junto a Elisa Aguilar, presidenta de la FEB, han conseguido una foto histórica para el baloncesto español. "Me niego a hacer excepcional lo que debe ser normal", apuntó Martín. Un evento que ha servido además para homenajear y reconocer a la selección femenina de baloncesto que acaba de conseguir el bronce Mundial en Berlín. Alba Torrens y Mariona Ortiz, protagonistas en el Especial de Radio MARCA. "Alba dijo desde el primer día que lo más importante era creer. Sí lo visualizamos", reconoció Mariona. "El compromiso, el trabajo y la unión del equipo han estado para poder conseguirlo", señaló la capitana Alba Torrens. Desfile de protagonistas en una tarde de radio espectacular y que hace vislumbrar una temporada de emociones fuertes. Willy Hernangómez ha sido uno de los grandes nombres del verano al fichar por Unicaja de Málaga. "Disfrutar de ser un afortunado de hacer lo que más me gusta. Txus me está ayudando mucho a coger confianza y sensaciones. La unión y la química que hay fuera de la pista es muy grande. Estoy muy ilusionado y motivado", apuntó en la radio del deporte. Willy ocupará el sitio que deja Olek Balcerowski en el equipo malagueño y es que el polaco es una de las 11 caras nuevas que presenta el nuevo Barça de Aleksander Sekulic. "Estar en un club tan grande conlleva competir por todos los títulos. Estamos aquí para intentar devolverles la ilusión a los aficionados", valoró. Otro de los equipos que más ha cambiado durante el verano es el vigente campeón de Liga, el Valencia Basket, que ha traído de regreso a la ACB al joven talento malagueño Mario Saint Supery tras su año en Gonzaga. "Estaba contento en Estados Unidos pero me salió esta oportunidad, que era imposible de rechazar", explicó un Saint Supery contento de compartir vestuario con Nikola Mirotic. "Ha sido una sorpresa, muchas ganas de poder compartir vestuario con un jugador con Mirotic". Una temporada que alza el telón y que promete a buen seguro volver a dejar momentos para el recuerdo. "Nos hace estar muy felices poder juntar a las dos ligas. Poder hacer eventos como este son las cosas que te da el Baloncesto", explicó Ignacio Asensi, director de Patrocinios de Endesa.

articles.title: Histórica presentación conjunta de la Liga Endesa y la Liga Femenina Endesa
articles.standfirst: Las dos competiciones alzaron el telón al mismo tiempo en un evento que reunió a la gran familia del baloncesto español
articles.summary: Las dos competiciones alzaron el telón al mismo tiempo en un evento que reunió a la gran familia del baloncesto español
articles.body: El baloncesto español encendió la mecha de la temporada 2026-27 a lo grande. La Liga Endesa y la Liga Femenina Endesa alzaron el telón del nuevo curso juntas por primera vez en la historia, en una presentación que aunó la fuerza, el crecimiento y la energía de dos competiciones que comparten mucho más que patrocinador. La sede central de Endesa en Madrid se convirtió en el escenario de una gala que reunió a las grandes estrellas del baloncesto masculino y femenino nacional para poner en marcha una nueva campaña cargada de retos y ambición. Fue una puesta de largo original, concebida como un gran espectáculo y con el baloncesto como protagonista absoluto. La humorista Eva Soriano y el periodista de DAZN Sergio Perela ejercieron de maestros de ceremonias en un acto donde se congregó al completo la familia del baloncesto español. La histórica presentación fue auspiciada por el presidente del Consejo Superior de Deportes (CSD), José Manuel Rodríguez Uribes, flanqueado en todo momento por la presidenta de la Federación Española de Baloncesto (FEB), Elisa Aguilar, especialmente feliz por la conquista de la medalla de bronce en el Mundial Femenino, y por el presidente de la Asociación de Clubes de Baloncesto, Antonio Martín. “El baloncesto es uno y trabajamos para transmitir esos valores. Nuestro objetivo es potenciar nuestro deporte para que siga siendo el mejor de Europa. El crecimiento continúa, pero no veo techo”, aseguró Aguilar. “Me niego a hacer excepcional lo que debería ser normal. El baloncesto va a romper una vez más las dinámicas perjudiciales actuales y vamos a trabajar juntos”, dijo Martín. La temporada en la Liga Endesa se presenta abierta dados los muchos cambios que han sufrido los aspirantes al título. Entre el Real Madrid, que parece un peldaño por delante del resto; el Valencia Basket, vigente campeón; y el Barcelona, sediento de títulos, suman 28 fichajes contando con el último de Nikola Mirotic por el cuadro taronja y con la inminente llegada de Nick Smith Jr. al equipo blanco. Cómo sea la adaptación de todos esos fichajes marcará el curso. "Es un orgullo vestir esta camiseta. Todo el mundo sabe lo que representa este escudo y aquí el objetivo es ganar títulos", comentaba Olek Balcerowski, uno de los 11 refuerzos de un Barça que tratará de romper esa nefasta racha de tres temporadas en blanco. La Supercopa Endesa, este fin de semana será la primera oportunidad. Jaime Pradilla, uno de los fichajes del Real Madrid, ya sentía "la presión que siempre hay en este equipo por ganar. Desde el primer día te intentan transmitir esa competitividad. El escudo del Madrid te lleva a pelear hasta el final". La histórica presentación sirvió también de homenaje para la selección femenina, que este domingo se colgó el bronce en el Mundial de Berlín. Cuatro integrantes del equipo estuvieron presentes: la capitana Alba Torrens (Azulmarino Palma), Mariona Ortiz (Casademont Zaragoza), Helena Pueyo (Valencia Basket) e Iyana Martín (Spar Girona), que fue una de las grandes protagonistas del evento tras formar parte del quinteto ideal del torneo. "Las últimas 48 horas han sido como un torbellino. La exposición del Mundial ha sido muy elevada. Ha habido mucha gente que lo ha visto y que opina o que escribe, pero yo siempre intento llevármelo a casa, que es donde me mantienen siempre los pies en el suelo, con humildad", comentaba la base, que ha cambiado Salamanca por Girona y desde allí intentará plantar cara a un Valencia Basket que ha ganado las últimas cuatro ediciones de la Liga Femenina Endesa y es el gran favorito para sumar una más.

articles.title: Everything Adam Silver Said About NBA's Kawhi Leonard Probe, Clippers Punishment, Expansion, More
articles.summary: NBA commissioner Adam Silver discussed a variety of topics surrounding the Association during a press conference following Tuesday's Board of Governors meeting.
articles.body:
NBA commissioner Adam Silver discussed a variety of topics surrounding the Association during a press conference following Tuesday's Board of Governors meeting.

Silver gave his thoughts on the league's penalties for the Los Angeles Clippers following an investigation into the team for violating salary cap circumvention rules regarding endorsement deals for Kawhi Leonard.

"The core responsibility of the league is to have a set of rules that everyone agrees to operate under, and the league's responsibility to enforce those rules, Silver said, per ESPN's Vincent Goodwill . "If those rules are found to be violated, there then will be appropriate consequences."

He explained why the NBA wanted to find balance in Los Angeles' penalties as well.

"That's in some ways the most difficult part of adjudicating these disputes because while there have to be competitive consequences, in our view, if these rules are by are violated, we still want to be a 30-team league, and we recognize that in some ways we're unfortunately punishing the fans of that team as well," Silver said, per Mike Vorkunov of The Athletic.

Silver also confirmed that Clippers governor Steve Ballmer wasn't present at the Board of Governors meetings. Ballmer is suspended for one year following the league's investigation.

While the Clippers initially announced that they rejected the league's decision, they eventually complied with the punishments on Sunday.

"I appreciate that he has stood down, that he did apologize, and is accepting responsibility … our plan is to move forward, and we have every reason to believe … (he) will return to be an owner in good standing," Silver said about Ballmer, per Sportsnet's Michael Grange .

Silver also commented on the ongoing talks regarding renovations for the Portland Trail Blazers' Moda Center.

"We need a state-of-the-art arena," Silver said, via ClutchPoints' Brett Siegel . "The current building there is in the bottom measure of any arena in the league... It's my hope that we can lower the temperature in these negotiations."

Silver also revealed that the Board of Governors meeting covered expansion, although Las Vegas received more attention than Seattle due to questions about the location of a new arena.

"It's our goal to have decisions by the end of the year, and that continues to be our goal," Silver told reporters Tuesday.

He confirmed that the NBA visited Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle to study the venue's visibility while explaining that "it's a much longer timeline" to starting play in Las Vegas compared to Seattle, per Vorkunov .

ESPN's Shams Charania also reported that the NBA and Silver are in "deeper stages" of the expansion conversation.

"I'm told specifically for Las Vegas, the next round of bids for an expansion team in Las Vegas are due on Thursday and then final bids expected to be some point shortly thereafter," Charania said during a Tuesday appearance on NBA Today (0:20 mark). "My understanding is proposals for that Vegas team is reaching and potentially exceeding $10 billion. So far, the Vegas process has moved with more pace than Seattle. But those Seattle conversations are continuing as well."

On March 25, the Board of Governors approved a vote to formally explore bids and applicants for expansion teams in Las Vegas and Seattle.

Vorkunov previously reported that there was belief the league will select a governor for the Las Vegas organization before finalizing an agreement for Seattle.

Multiple bidders in Las Vegas have already submitted economic packages, according to David Aldridge and Joe Vardon of The Athletic. Meanwhile, Seattle's bid had centered on a single group headed by Samantha Holloway. Holloway is the owner of the NHL's Seattle Kraken.

As for the Trail Blazers, they were purchased by a group led by Tom Dundon at a valuation of $4.25 billion in March.

Dundon and the city of Portland have been in discussions surrounding funding for Moda Center renovations.

Jason Quick of The Athletic reported Aug. 15 that the framework for funding more than $586 million had been agreed to by the state of Oregon, the city of Portland and Multnomah County. However, the terms have not been agreed to with the city and county.

There is a Portland city council vote scheduled on Dec. 17.

If an agreement is reached, the Trail Blazers will be secured in Portland through the 2049-2050 season (via Quick). If both sides can't agree, the $365 million committed by the Oregon state legislature will expire on Dec. 31 and make the long-term location of the organization uncertain after the current lease expires in Oct. 2030.

articles.title: New NBA Rumors on Expansion Timeline, Franchise Values for Las Vegas, Seattle
articles.summary: The NBA Board of Governors previously authorized an exploration of expansion into Las Vegas and Seattle back in March, and now the process is advancing into further stages, per ESPN's Shams Charania, who provided an update on Tuesday's edition of NBA Today.
articles.body:
The NBA Board of Governors previously authorized an exploration of expansion into Las Vegas and Seattle back in March, and now the process is advancing into further stages, per ESPN's Shams Charania, who provided an update on Tuesday's edition of NBA Today .

"The NBA and [Commissioner Adam Silver] are in deeper and deeper stages of the expansion conversation, and I'm told specifically for Las Vegas the next round of bids for an expansion team in Las Vegas are due on Thursday, and then final bids expected to be some point shortly thereafter. My understanding is proposals for that Vegas team is reaching and potentially exceeding $10 billion, and so far, the Vegas process has moved with more pace than Seattle, but those Seattle conversations are continuing as well.

"And remember, the league has been targeting as soon as the 2028-29 season for the start of these expansion teams, and they all are also projecting both teams to be in the top 10 in terms of market and revenue share moving forward.

"And so right now, Adam Silver is gonna continue the bids process, and it's unclear when a final vote would be, and I think over the next couple of months, we're gonna get clarity on the final offers, potentially $10 billion-ish in Las Vegas, potentially $7 billion range in Seattle, and then a potential vote to finalize expansion to 32 teams."

Seattle was home to the beloved SuperSonics from 1967-2008, and the team won three Western Conference titles and one NBA championship.

The team relocated to Oklahoma City and became the Thunder shortly after Clay Bennett and his ownership group bought the team in 2006.

The city and that fanbase certainly deserves another NBA team and already supports a host of successful professional sports franchises.

Las Vegas is the home of the NBA's annual summer league, where games are played every July at the Thomas & Mack Center and Cox Pavilion.

The league also hosts the semifinal and championship matchups of the Emirates NBA Cup in Las Vegas' T-Mobile Arena.

Las Vegas has become a professional sports hotbed in the last decade with the Golden Knights, Aces and Raiders calling the city home and the Athletics shortly doing the same in 2028.

Mick Akers of the Las Vegas Review-Journal gave a rundown of the Vegas ownership groups in the running. They include a group led by Golden Knights owner Bill Foley, a group led by ex-Phoenix Suns owner Jerry Colangelo (dubbed the "Las Vegas Jacks"). Akers also said that "Walmart heiress Nancy Walton Laurie and her husband, Bill, are also in the mix ," and he added there is a fourth group that has "not been publicly identified."

As for Seattle, commissioner Adam Silver had high praise for Climate Pledge Arena, home of the WNBA's Storm and NHL's Kraken.

"In Seattle, we have had operational groups out to Climate Pledge," Silver said Tuesday, per KOMO News Senior Reporter Chris Daniels . "You clearly have a state-of-the-art arena there."

"It may require some modifications for NBA basketball, but if we were opening, you know, in five weeks, we could be ready in Seattle," Silver also noted. "So, because we can only take on so much at once, the more of the discussion was around Las Vegas."

As far as a potential ownership group, Cameron Van Til of Seattle Sports gave insight into a clear candidate back in May.

"One Roof Sports and Entertainment, launched by Seattle Kraken ownership as a parent brand on Monday, has already emerged as a potential candidate. One Roof CEO Tod Leiweke confirmed to KING 5 on Wednesday that the group will pursue ownership of a Seattle NBA expansion team.

"However, NBA commissioner Adam Silver said during a press conference Wednesday that he expects 'multiple bidders' in Seattle and Las Vegas."

Ultimately, all signs are pointing to Seattle and Las Vegas getting teams. We're still some ways from that becoming a reality, but the table is set.

articles.title: Chad Baker-Mazara Sues USC and Eric Musselman, Alleging NIL Pay Dispute and Racial Remarks
articles.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Former Southern California basketball player Chad Baker-Mazara is suing the university and coach Eric Musselman after his abrupt dismissal from the team in March.
articles.body:
LOS ANGELES (AP) — Former Southern California basketball player Chad Baker-Mazara is suing the university and coach Eric Musselman after his abrupt dismissal from the team in March.

The lawsuit filed Monday in Los Angeles Superior Court alleges Musselman kicked Baker-Mazara off the team after the Trojans were eliminated from NCAA Tournament contention to avoid paying the remainder of his NIL contract.

It also alleges Musselman directed racially charged remarks at Baker-Mazara following a Feb. 28 loss to 12th-ranked Nebraska. The Trojans were in the midst of losing eight straight games to end the season.

Baker-Mazara alleges breach of contract, conversion and intentional interference with prospective economic advantage in the lawsuit, which doesn't state a specific dollar amount he is seeking.

"The decision to remove the student-athlete from the men's basketball roster was based on a number of considerations, none having to do with race," USC said Tuesday in a statement. "We look forward to defeating this action in court."

Baker-Mazara claims the Trojans terminated his NIL agreements with the program the day after he was removed from the roster on March 1, stating he had violated a "morals clause." The lawsuit alleges USC has not paid the remainder of the promised NIL earnings.

"I gave everything I had to USC. I played through injuries, showed up for my teammates every day, and honored my commitments," Baker-Mazara said Tuesday in a statement from his publicist. "Filing this lawsuit was not an easy decision, but I believe it is important to stand up for what you were promised and what you are owed."

The lawsuit cites a locker room incident after the Trojans' loss to Nebraska in which Baker-Mazara claimed Musselman "lost his mind" during a profanity-laced tirade in front of the team.

Baker-Mazara attempted to address his teammates in the locker room, the lawsuit says, when Musselman said, "You shut the (expletive) up! You are one of the worst teammates anyone can ever have!"

Baker-Mazara responded, "Wow Coach, do you need me to leave because I don't understand this animosity," according to the lawsuit.

Musselman responded, "Yes, leave! Go back to the (expletive) Dominican Republic! Nobody wants you here!! (Expletive) you!," the lawsuit states.

Baker-Mazara, a 26-year-old from the Dominican Republic, took the comments to be racist and discriminatory, according to the lawsuit first obtained by The California Post.

The next day, Baker-Mazara was dropped from the team. The lawsuit says USC never gave him a reason for his dismissal.

Baker-Mazara averaged 18.5 points as the team's second-leading scorer while starting 22 of 26 games for the struggling Trojans last season, including a 14-point effort the 82-67 loss to Nebraska a day before being dismissed. At the time, no reason or details were provided in a brief statement from the school.

He wasn't selected in this year's NBA draft.

Baker-Mazara was MVP of the Maui Invitational, won by the Trojans last November.

USC was Baker-Mazara's fifth school. He began his college career at Duquesne before transferring to San Diego State for his second season, when he earned Mountain West Conference sixth man of the year honors.

He went from there to Northwest Florida State College for one season and transferred to Auburn for two seasons, where he helped the Tigers reach the Final Four in 2025. He left Auburn to join USC for his final collegiate season.

articles.summary: El seleccionador nacional fue protagonista en el programa 'Otra Ronda' de Radio MARCA
articles.body: Chus Mateo está a punto de cumplir un año al frente de la selección española de baloncesto. El próximo 22 de septiembre se cumplirá un año desde su llegada al cargo y el técnico ha repasado en 'Otra Ronda', el programa nocturno de Radio MARCA presentado por Carlos Vicente Gómez 'Chitu', junto a Carlos Santos, especialista en baloncesto de Radio MARCA, sus primeros meses como seleccionador y el reto que tiene por delante: lograr la clasificación para el próximo Mundial. El técnico reconoce que su trabajo ha cambiado respecto a su etapa como entrenador de club. "Uno cuando le falta la cancha echa mucho mucho de menos entrenar a diario, pero sí que es verdad que haces otro tipo de trabajo y mucho de seguimiento, mucho de tratar de ver cómo vas a encarar algo que en ocasiones no puedes predecir del todo", explicó. Mateo también destacó la necesidad de adaptarse a una realidad en la que no siempre puede disponer de todos los jugadores. Precisamente, la adaptación es una de las principales enseñanzas que se lleva de su primer año como seleccionador. "Para cualquier entrenador pero concretamente para en esta situación es muy muy importante el ser capaz de adaptarte, no poner excusas, saber lo que hay y bueno y tratar de conseguir el objetivo sin pensar mucho más allá", señaló. El objetivo inmediato es claro: conseguir el billete para el Mundial. España llega a las próximas ventanas después de dos derrotas que han complicado el camino, aunque Mateo mantiene intacta su confianza. "Soy muy optimista, siempre lo soy", aseguró antes de lanzar un mensaje rotundo: "Vamos a conseguir el objetivo". El seleccionador también quiso poner en valor el nivel del baloncesto español y la capacidad de los jugadores que han participado en las ventanas. "El baloncesto nacional goza de muy buena salud", afirmó, destacando también el trabajo realizado por los clubes y por los entrenadores españoles. Una de las cuestiones planteadas por Carlos Santos fue el hándicap que supone no poder contar con jugadores de Euroliga o NBA durante las ventanas internacionales. La respuesta de Mateo fue clara: "Lo conseguiremos, conseguiremos el objetivo, de una manera o de otra, con Euroligas, NBA o sin ellos". El técnico considera que España cuenta con un nivel medio suficientemente alto para competir pese a las ausencias. "Seguramente se reduce un poco el abanico cuando no puedes elegir entre todos, pero eso no significa, no es sinónimo ni mucho menos de hacer un peor baloncesto", explicó. Para Mateo, la clave está en construir un equipo con tiempo. "Nosotros necesitamos saber a qué jugamos, necesitamos conocernos, necesitamos equivocarnos, necesitamos acertar juntos, es un proceso", señaló. "Yo creo mucho en esta palabra, en el proceso y el proceso requiere de un cierto tiempo para madurar". Durante la entrevista, Carlos Santos también preguntó a Chus Mateo por la llegada de Pedro Martínez al banquillo del Real Madrid. El seleccionador evitó hacer quinielas sobre la temporada, pero sí tuvo palabras de reconocimiento para el nuevo técnico blanco. "Creo que Pedro es un extraordinario entrenador, campeón de liga del año pasado, campeón de supercopa, bueno, lleva muchos, muchos años en esta liga, conoce perfectamente la competición", explicó. Mateo destacó la trayectoria del entrenador y su capacidad para representar al baloncesto español. "Me parece una apuesta muy decidida, con mucha personalidad", señaló. "Creo que representa francamente el baloncesto nacional, habiendo estado tantos partidos representando a unos u otros clubes". En la parte más personal de la entrevista, Chus Mateo descubrió también cómo desconecta lejos de las pistas. "A mí me gusta mucho pasar tiempo con los amigos, soy un poco un animal social, me gusta mucho estar acompañado", contó. El técnico explicó que disfruta reuniéndose con amigos y familia para "hablar del mundo, de cómo funciona este mundo de hoy en día", además de ver series y cine con su mujer y dedicar tiempo a la lectura. Una conversación que terminó de la manera más apropiada para un programa llamado 'Otra Ronda': "Esa relación, si es posible, con una cerveza, te puedo decir que es lo que más valoro".

articles.title: Balcerowski: "En un equipo como el Barça, siempre tienes que tener títulos y victorias como primer reto"
articles.standfirst: El pívot azulgrana analizó la pretemporada de su equipo, que lleva tres años en blanco
articles.summary: El pívot azulgrana analizó la pretemporada de su equipo, que lleva tres años en blanco
articles.body: Olek Balcerowski, pívot polaco del Barça, afirmó que el equipo va con "muy buena mentalidad" de cara a la Supercopa Endesa, la cual disputarán este fin de semana y en la que se medirán al Valencia Basket en las semifinales. El nuevo jugador azulgrana reconoció sentirse "muy bien" en su nuevo equipo, que también estará bajo la batuta de un nuevo entrenador, Aleksander Sekulic, durante la presentación de la Liga Endesa y la Liga Femenina Endesa, este martes en Madrid. "Llevo un par de días en Barcelona y me siento muy bien. Es un equipo completamente nuevo, con muchos jugadores nuevos. Todavía hemos tenido poco tiempo de jugar juntos, todavía nos estamos conociendo, pero yo creo que cada día estamos dando muchos pasos adelante y mejorando mucho, y eso es lo más importante. Yo me siento muy bien, muy orgulloso de poder vestir la camiseta del Barça y poder ayudar al equipo", comentó. Con la posibilidad de levantar el primer título este fin de semana, reconoció que el equipo va con la mentalidad correcta a la Supercopa de Badalona: "Como he dicho antes, estamos cada día intentando mejorar cada cosa que hacemos. También, como he dicho, hemos tenido poco tiempo de trabajar juntos, así que cada día ahora para nosotros vale oro. Vamos con muy buena mentalidad y cada día estamos mejorando y preparándonos para la Supercopa". En ese nuevo estilo que desea ver el renovado Barça, enumeró el físico y el ritmo como premisas claves en el juego de Sekulic. "Un tipo de baloncesto muy físico. Saliendo mucho de la defensa, sobre todo trabajando de la defensa hacia contraataque, corriendo muchísimo. Más o menos eso, mucho físico, mucho correr, mucho ritmo", analizó. En un Barça con dos años sin títulos, la presión cada vez es mayor. Pese a ello, comentó que "mentalmente" debes estar listo para vestir la camiseta de un equipo grande. "Mentalmente tienes que estar preparado para si vienes a un equipo así de grande, siempre tienes que tener títulos y victorias como primer reto. Aquí estamos pensando en lo alto, queremos hacer la mejor temporada posible y pues tenemos nuestros retos", continuó. En esa línea, remarcó el "hambre" y la "ambición" de la plantilla para acabar con la sequía de trofeos. "Sí, bueno, nosotros tenemos cada título que viene en nuestra mente. Estamos ahí peleando y entrenando cada día sabiendo que tenemos puesto aquí el escudo, que este escudo con esa camiseta viene una responsabilidad y cada uno de nosotros sabe lo que conviene. Y que tenemos que estar preparados para pelear las cosas más altas", concluyó.

articles.title: Pradilla: "El escudo del Madrid te lleva a pelear hasta el final"
articles.standfirst: El nuevo ala-pívot del conjunto blanco analiza la temporada que está a punto de arrancar
articles.summary: El nuevo ala-pívot del conjunto blanco analiza la temporada que está a punto de arrancar
articles.body: Jaime Pradilla fue uno de los protagonistas de la presentación de la Liga Endesa. El ala-pívot fue el representante de un Real Madrid muy renovado con él como uno de los siete fichajes (aún queda por anunciar el de Nick Smith Jr.) y con la llegada de Pedro Martínez al banquillo. El internacional destacó que una de las cosas que ha sentido a su llegada al Madrid es que "desde el primer día te transmiten lo competitivo que es". Y ponía el ejemplo de Sergio Llull: "Lo competitivo que es y cómo encesta los tiros en el último segundo. Yo creo que al final eso está todo ligado a ser competitivo y luchar hasta el final, que creo que es lo que lleva el escudo, que representamos el pelear hasta el final. Y creo que eso es lo que más admiro del equipo". Pradilla agradecía "lo fácil que los compañeros hacen la adaptación de los nuevos" mientras ansía "empezar a competir". El estreno oficial del Real Madrid será en la nueva Supercopa de la Euroliga, en la que se medirá en semifinales al Dubái Basketball de Xavi Pascual. De los primeros entrenamientos con el club blanco destaca "que hay una grandísima plantilla y al final hay grandísimos jugadores con muchísimo talento". El jugador que más le ha sorprendido es "Edy [Tavares], por la movilidad que tiene y por lo grande que es y las cosas que hace dentro de la pista". En los amistosos disputados se ha podido ver algo del baloncesto que hará este nuevo Madrid de Pedro Martínez. "Un juego alegre, un juego dinámico y al final yo creo que eso lo que nos va a dar es competir hasta el final y que nosotros no lo pasamos bien en pista y hacer a la afición a disfrutar", analizaba. También ha notado a su llegada al Madrid la presión que hay por ganar. "Todos los equipos tienen esa presión, pero la afrontamos con ilusión, con ganas de poder competir por todo y con esa ambición". En la Supercopa Endesa, donde el Real Madrid no participará al no haberse clasificado, Pradilla tiene favoritismo por su antiguo equipo, el Valencia Basket. "Cuando la ganamos el año pasado, dije que agradecía a mis compañeros del año anterior por haber competido para poder estar clasificados en esa competición y, dentro de lo que cabe, Valencia está en mi corazón y creo que se lo merecen. Estaría muy contento de que se la llevaran", sentenció.

articles.title: La NBA cambia de plan: ahora quiere conquistar Europa de la mano de la Euroliga
articles.standfirst: El comisionado de la NBA admite públicamente que la única manera de desembarcar en Europa es con una alianza con la Euroliga
articles.summary: El comisionado de la NBA admite públicamente que la única manera de desembarcar en Europa es con una alianza con la Euroliga
articles.body: La NBA empieza a asumir una realidad que durante meses se resistió a reconocer: Europa no se conquista desde fuera cuando ya existe una competición consolidada como la Euroliga, se construye desde dentro. Adam Silver ha cambiado el discurso y sus últimas declaraciones de esta misma noche apuntan directamente hacia una alianza con la Euroliga. “Para el bien del baloncesto europeo, el mejor resultado sería que nos uniéramos con la Euroliga”, acaba de reconocer el comisionado. Una frase que supone un giro trascendental en la hoja de ruta de NBA Europa y que coloca a la competición continental en el centro de un proyecto que inicialmente pretendía desarrollarse al margen de ella. La NBA había emprendido el camino de la mano de FIBA, con la intención de crear una nueva competición europea con franquicias permanentes y plazas de acceso deportivo. El proyecto es de una dimensión gigantesca, con una previsión de 12 equipos permanentes y otros cuatro que accederían por méritos deportivos. Pero una cosa es tener el músculo económico y comercial de la NBA y otra muy distinta crear una estructura deportiva, una identidad y una legitimidad que Europa lleva décadas construyendo. FIBA puede aportar el respaldo institucional, pero no puede fabricar de la noche a la mañana la historia, los clubes y la masa social que ya posee la Euroliga. Y Silver parece haber entendido finalmente que el camino más corto hacia esa nueva Europa pasa precisamente por quien ya la está organizando. “Siempre tuvimos la esperanza de poder crear algún tipo de consolidación del baloncesto europeo. Sigo siendo optimista respecto a que podremos conseguirlo”, afirmó en julio. Es mucho más que una declaración diplomática: la palabra clave es consolidación. La NBA ya no habla únicamente de crear una competición nueva, sino de integrar fuerzas con la estructura existente. Y ahí la Euroliga deja de ser rival para convertirse en socio imprescindible. La paradoja es evidente. La NBA llegó a Europa dispuesta a crear su propio producto con FIBA como aliado y a avanzar “independientemente” de la postura de la Euroliga. Ahora es el propio Silver quien reconoce que el mejor escenario pasa por unir ambos proyectos. Mientras la NBA aporta la dimensión global, financiera y comercial, la Euroliga pone sobre la mesa los clubes, la tradición, la competición, los mercados y el conocimiento del ecosistema europeo. Incluso Silver ha subrayado que la NBA quiere respetar la historia y las tradiciones del baloncesto del continente. Por eso, NBA Europa empieza a parecer menos una invasión y más una fusión. La NBA mantiene intacta su ambición de desembarcar en el continente, pero Silver admite que hacerlo contra la Euroliga sería mucho más complicado que hacerlo con ella. FIBA seguirá siendo una pieza fundamental, especialmente por su red federativa y por el acceso deportivo, pero la gran revelación es que la NBA parece haber descubierto que para construir el futuro europeo necesita apoyarse en el presente. Y ese presente tiene nombre propio: Euroliga. La nueva gran batalla ya no será decidir si habrá NBA Europa, sino quién tendrá el poder y cómo se repartirá el mando cuando ambas estructuras se sienten finalmente a la misma mesa.
